evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Recent advances in large audio-language models (LALMs) have broadened audio understanding across speech, sound, and music, with tool-based agents further supporting these tasks by invoking predefined audio tools.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: Extensive evaluations on two benchmarks spanning seven audio categories demonstrate that Think2Listen achieves (I) enhanced multi-step audio reasoning, with gains in overall accuracy of 5.08%--17.67% over competing audio agents; and (II) improved audio understanding and reasoning across speech, sound, and music, boosting overall accuracy by 2.29%--13.10% over the corresponding baselines.
